name: dax_selectedvalue_counts_blank_as_a_value
expect_sql:
SELECT t.season,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.region) = 1 AND COUNT(t.region) = COUNT(*) THEN MIN(t.region) WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 AND COUNT(t.region) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'Several' END AS selected_region
FROM   retail.fct_sales t
GROUP BY t.season
